    Tendsto d l (𝓝 0) := by
  have : ∀ᶠ n in l, (c n)⁻¹ • c n • d n = d n :=
    (eventually_ne_of_tendsto_norm_atTop hc 0).mono fun n hn ↦ inv_smul_smul₀ hn (d n)
  simpa using ((tendsto_inv₀_cobounded.comp (tendsto_norm_atTop_iff_cobounded.1 hc)).smul hd).congr' this
